title: Stainless steel carafe.
text: Stainless steel carafe.. OOoo.  This carafe keeps your liquid of choice hot for HOURS.  I use it for tea.  I made a pot in the morning around 8 am, it was still scalding hot at 7:30 pm.  That is impressive. I love this carafe.  It is easy to clean. Stainless steel (awesome for cleaning and safe for any beverage including lemon), double walled.  It holds a large volume.  And keeps your beverage honestly hot.  I would buy this again.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
